content.text: The app is up. Now the end-to-end smoke test of all token paths.

input.command:
set -e
B=http://localhost:8080/api
T1=$(curl -s -X POST $B/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"user1","password":"user123"}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]["token"])')
T2=$(curl -s -X POST $B/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"admin","password":"admin123"}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]["token"])')
H1="Authorization: Bearer $T1"; H2="Authorization: Bearer $T2"; CT='Content-Type: application/json'
WS=$(curl -s $B/workspaces -H "$H1" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin)["data"];print([w["id"] for w in d if w["name"]=="产品研发空间"][0])')
echo "seeded workspace id=$WS"
echo "--- 1. owner adds admin (success)"
curl -s -X POST $B/workspaces/members -H "$H1" -H "$CT" -d "{\"workspaceId\":$WS,\"username\":\"admin\",\"memberRole\":\"ADMIN\"}"; echo
echo "--- 2. duplicate -> ALREADY_MEMBER"
curl -s -X POST $B/workspaces/members -H "$H1" -H "$CT" -d "{\"workspaceId\":$WS,\"username\":\"admin\",\"memberRole\":\"ADMIN\"}"; echo
echo "--- 3. add owner themself -> USER_IS_OWNER"
curl -s -X POST $B/workspaces/members -H "$H1" -H "$CT" -d "{\"workspaceId\":$WS,\"username\":\"user1\",\"memberRole\":\"MEMBER\"}"; echo
echo "--- 4. unknown user -> USER_NOT_FOUND"
curl -s -X POST $B/workspaces/members -H "$H1" -H "$CT" -d "{\"workspaceId\":$WS,\"username\":\"ghost\",\"memberRole\":\"MEMBER\"}"; echo
echo "--- 5. unknown workspace -> WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND"
curl -s -X POST $B/workspaces/members -H "$H1" -H "$CT" -d '{"workspaceId":99999,"username":"admin","memberRole":"MEMBER"}'; echo
echo "--- 6. non-member non-owner caller -> ACCESS_DENIED"
curl -s -X POST $B/workspaces/members -H "$H2" -H "$CT" -d "{\"workspaceId\":$WS,\"username\":\"writer1\",\"memberRole\":\"MEMBER\"}"; echo
echo "--- 7. admin member adds writer1 (success)"
curl -s -X POST $B/workspaces/members -H "$H2" -H "$CT" -d "{\"workspaceId\":$WS,\"username\":\"writer1\",\"memberRole\":\"EDITOR\"}"; echo
echo "--- 8. list members"
curl -s $B/workspaces/$WS/members -H "$H1"; echo
